systems.name: 5.1 Main Menu & Title
systems.notes: Atmospheric title screen with eerie music. New Game, Load Game, Options. Typewriter‑style save slots.
tasks: Title screen with animated fog / candle

systems.name: 5.2 Save / Load System
systems.notes: Save points (typewriter or safe room). Save state includes player health, inventory, room states, and enemy positions.
tasks: Autosave on room entry (optional, hardcore mode)

systems.name: 5.3 In‑Game Pause & Map
systems.notes: Pause overlay with inventory, file, map. Map shows explored rooms and player location.
